record.field: Create or update a CRM lead with data gathered from the conversation. Pass a "fields" dict with field names and values (use get_model_schema with model="crm.lead" to see available fields). Handles create-or-update automatically based on the current chat room. Resolves partner, salesperson and phone automatically when available.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"fields": {"type": "object", "description": "Dict of crm.lead field names mapped to values, e.g. {\"name\": \"John - interested in product X\", \"contact_name\": \"John\", \"email_from\": \"john@example.com\", \"description\": \"Looking for a quote on 50 units\"}"}}, "required": ["fields"]}

Update an existing CRM lead with new or corrected information from the conversation. Unlike save_lead (which only fills empty fields), this overwrites the provided fields with the new values. Use this when the customer gives updated details: new phone, corrected name, expanded description, changed priority, etc. Finds the lead linked to the current chat room unless lead_id is specified.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"fields": {"type": "object", "description": "Dict of crm.lead field names to new values. All provided fields will be overwritten."}, "lead_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "Optional lead ID. If omitted, uses the lead linked to the current chat room."}}, "required": ["fields"]}
